## This week

The context window as a finite, priced, position-biased resource: Lost in the Middle, budget management by selection, ordering, and compression, and the harness. Then memory beyond the session: storage, retrieval, and update (MemGPT paging, Mem0 update operations).

## Lab

Long-term memory lab + wrapping the semester's modules as graph nodes (published before class).

Run it in Colab: download the notebook, go to [colab.research.google.com](https://colab.research.google.com) → Upload, paste your API key into the setup cell ([API Setup](api-setup.qmd)), and run top to bottom.
